question: Should raw-67 Heal Missing or Maximum Health (no CannotCrit) be able to critically heal?
why_unknown: Core deliberately shares the impact critical result (development-ledger.md:2719-2723; healing.rs:211-236); probes show the Full Heal request doubles and the caster-maximum branch (all First Aid 7162 facts) doubles committed healing (400 -> 800). Trinity never crits a pure raw-67 spell (effect 67 absent from CU_CAN_CRIT list SpellMgr.cpp:3073-3087; EffectHealMaxHealth SpellEffects.cpp:2966-2987) and simc hard-codes lay_on_hands may_crit=false (sc_paladin.cpp:728); but live player Lay on Hands 633/471195/234320 carry CannotCrit (attribute 93) explicitly, which suggests the effect is crit-capable without it.
reopen: Combat-log evidence of a raw-67 spell without attribute 93 (e.g. First Aid 7162, Bandaging 274450) critting or not; if it never crits, promote to a LIVE finding with probe_tests c_missing_max_heal_crit.rs::* and correction at program.rs:1180-1205.
